scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Do you have business with me?
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
你有事找我嗎？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Upgrade equipments
scripts.translation: 升級裝備

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
I came to the ruined village,
looking for some materials. Touched some strange light, and now I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
我來這座廢棄村莊尋找一些材料。
不小心碰到了某種奇怪的光，然後就來到這裡了。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
I've decided to stick around for a little while. Figured I'd be safe so long as I stay close to this soldier.
I have a proposition for you. I want some materials that can only be found in this place.
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
我決定在這裡停留一段時間。只要待在這個士兵附近，應該就安全了。
我有個提議。我需要一些只能在這個地方找到的材料。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Get them for me, and I'll improve your equipment in exchange. Just so you know, I can only improve certain types.
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
替我弄到它們，作為交換，我會幫你提升裝備。不過先說好，我只能提升特定型別的裝備。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
If you're interested, we can discuss the details of our bargain.
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
如果你感興趣，我們可以談談這筆交易的具體細節。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Make sure ^0000FFyour equipment is refined to at least +9^000000 before bringing it to me.
That's the minimum requirement for my upgrade service to have any visible effects on your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
在把裝備拿給我之前，請確保^0000FF你的裝備已經強化到至少+9^000000。
這是我的升級服務能對裝備產生可見效果所需的最低要求。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
Make sure you're ^0000FFequipped with the item that you want to improve.^000000
Otherwise, I can't evaluate its condition.
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
請確保^0000FF你身上正裝備著想要提升的物品^000000。
否則，我無法評估它的狀態。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
As you may have guessed, your equipment will transform into something new after this.
In other words, ^0000FFIt'll lose its current refining levels, cards and enchantments.^000000
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
你可能已經猜到了，經過這個過程後，你的裝備會變成全新的東西。
換句話說，^0000FF它將失去當前的強化等級、卡片和附魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[ Gemcutter ]
And I need ^0000FFIllusion Stones and some other materials^000000 to upgrade your equipment.
Pick an item you want and I'll tell you what I need.
scripts.translation:
[寶石切割師]
而且，我需要^0000FF幻影石和其他一些材料^000000來升級你的裝備。
選一件你想要的物品，我會告訴你我需要什麼。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Adventurer, do you have ^0000cdIllusion Stones^000000? If you have a ^0000cdweapon, a piece armor^000000, or ^0000cdan accessory at Refining Level 9 or higher^000000, 
then I can exchange it for something better at the cost of some Illusion Stones and other materials.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
冒險者，你有^0000cd幻影石^000000嗎？如果你有一件^0000cd武器、防具部件^000000或^0000cd強化等級9或以上的飾品^000000，
那麼我可以消耗一些幻影石和其他材料，將其兌換成更好的物品。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
So, what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
那麼，你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Exchange illusion equipment
scripts.translation: 兌換幻影裝備

scripts.text: What are Illusion Stones?
scripts.translation: 什麼是幻影石？

scripts.text: Can I strengthen the exchanged item?
scripts.translation: 兌換後的物品可以強化嗎？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Use it well and come see me later if you find more Illusion Stones! *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
好好利用它吧，如果你找到更多幻影石，歡迎再來找我！*輕笑*

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
What are ^0000cdIllusion Stones^000000, you ask? Well... I don't think anyone knows exactly what they are.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
你問什麼是^0000cd幻影石^000000嗎？嗯...我想沒有人確切知道它們是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
I only know they're rare and can only be found in some special places, and I'm here to collect them for my clients.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
我只知道它們很稀有，只能在某些特殊的地方找到，而我在這裡是為了替我的委託人收集它們。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
My clients want to figure out what these stones are. They're paying me a lot of money,
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
我的委託人想要弄清楚這些石頭到底是什麼。他們付了我一大筆錢，

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
so I could offer adventurers like you ^0000cdexpensive equipment in exchange for the stones^000000, and still fetch a profit.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
所以我可以用^0000cd昂貴的裝備來交換這些石頭^000000，給像你這樣的冒險者，同時還能賺取利潤。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Bring ^0000cda piece of refined equipment, Illusion Stones^000000, and various materials that are only found in this place. I'll ^0000cdupgrade the equipment, weapon, armor, or accessory?^000000for you.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
帶來^0000cd一件精煉過的裝備、幻影石^000000，以及只有這裡才有的各種材料。我會為您^0000cd升級裝備、武器、防具或飾品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
This benefits both of us. Let me know if you're interested in my proposition.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
這對我們雙方都有利。如果您對我的提議感興趣，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
So, you want to reinforce the equipment you get. You're thorough. I like that!
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
原來您想強化獲得的裝備。您真是一絲不苟，我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
A while ago, an adventurer who passed through this place told me that a chemist in Prontera refines the Illusion equipment in exchange for Illusion Stones.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
不久前，一位路過的冒險者告訴我，普隆德拉有一位鍊金術士，可以用幻影石來精煉幻影裝備。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
It seems Illusion Stones are a popular topic everywhere. Everyone wants to know about what they are.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
看來幻影石到處都很熱門。大家都想知道它們到底是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
If you want to refine your equipment, then go to the <NAVI>Illusion Enchanter<INFO>prontera,90,115,000,0,</INFO></NAVI> near the Town Office.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
如果您想精煉裝備，請去<NAVI>幻覺附魔師<INFO>prontera,90,115,000,0,</INFO></NAVI>，就在城鎮辦公室附近。

scripts.text:
[Great Merchant]
Did you find anything you liked? If you need anything, please let me know at any time.
scripts.translation:
[大商人]
您找到喜歡的東西了嗎？如果需要什麼，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
Ah, Illusion Stones are truly mysterious...
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
啊，幻影石真是神秘莫測...

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Upgrade equipments
scripts.translation: 升級裝備

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
I'm here to find some Illusion Stones that I need for my research.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
我來這裡是為了尋找我研究所需的幻影石。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
This cave is very mysterious, but I'm not strong enough to explore it by myself.
If you go in there, could you procure some things for me?
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
這個洞穴非常神秘，但我實力不夠，無法獨自探索。
如果您進去的話，能幫我收集一些東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
In exchange, I'll improve your equipment.
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
作為交換，我會改良您的裝備。
您覺得如何？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
Make sure ^4d4dffyour equipment is refined to at least +9^000000 before bringing it to me.
Make sure you're ^4d4dffequipped with the item that you want to improve^000000.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
請確保^4d4dff您的裝備至少精煉到+9^000000再帶給我。
請確保您^4d4dff身上裝備著想要改良的物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
As you may have guessed, your equipment will transform into something new after this.
In other words, ^4d4dffit'll lose its current Refining and Upgrade levels.^000000
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
如您所料，經過這個過程後，您的裝備將變成新的形態。
換句話說，^4d4dff它將失去當前的精煉和升級等級^000000。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
And I need ^4d4dffIllusion Stones and some other materials^000000 to upgrade your equipment.
Pick an item you want. I'll tell you what I need.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
升級您的裝備需要^4d4dff幻影石和其他一些材料^000000。
請選擇您想要的物品，我會告訴您需要什麼。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Stone Researcher]
It's just hard to get..
scripts.translation:
[幻覺石研究員]
只是很難弄到...

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先減輕一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Oh, do you have Illusion equipment?
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
哦，您有幻影裝備嗎？

scripts.text: No. I don't even know what Illusion equipment is.
scripts.translation: 沒有。我甚至不知道什麼是幻影裝備。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Oops, I'm sorry. I should've introduced myself first.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
哎呀，抱歉。我應該先自我介紹的。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
I'm a chemist specializing in the study of Illusion Stones, which have been circulating among adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
我是一名專門研究在冒險者中流傳的幻影石的鍊金術士。

scripts.text: Illusion Stones?
scripts.translation: 幻影石？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You don't know, don't you? They're the hottest trend these days.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
您不知道嗎？那可是最近最熱門的話題。

scripts.text: I don't care about trends.
scripts.translation: 我對潮流不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You must have heard about the strange places that have sprung up here and there lately. Illusion Stones are only found in those places,
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
您一定聽說過最近各地突然出現的奇怪地方吧。幻影石只存在於那些地方，

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
and their atomic structure is unlike any mineral I've seen. *Blah Blah* ...Their chemical chains... *Blah Blah*
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
而且它們的原子結構與我見過的任何礦石都不同。*巴拉巴拉*...它們的化學鏈... *巴拉巴拉*

scripts.text: (Uh-oh, he's zoning out!)
scripts.translation: (糟糕，他走神了！)

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Anyway, I can enchant equipment that is exchanged for or purchased with Illusion Stones. I call them the Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
總之，我可以為用幻影石交換或購買的裝備進行附魔。我稱之為幻影裝備。

scripts.text: (He has no sense when it comes to names.)
scripts.translation: (他起名字真是一點感覺都沒有。)

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This equipment at least responds positively to Illusion Stones, or it has the potential to be enchanted successfully.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
這些裝備至少對幻影石有積極的反應，或者具備成功附魔的潛力。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Explore the worlds of illusions, collect Illusion Stones, and exchange them for equipment. I can enchant the equipment for you.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
探索幻象世界，收集幻影石，並交換裝備。我可以為您附魔這些裝備。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This benefits both of us. I need Illusion Stones for my studies, and you need powerful equipment for your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
這對我們雙方都有利。我需要幻影石進行研究，而您需要強大的裝備來冒險。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
That said, my service is not for free. It requires a few Illusion Stones and Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
不過，我的服務不是免費的。這需要一些幻影石和Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
If you're interested, how'd you like to get a membership for my service? You can get discounts that way!
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
如果您感興趣，想成為我的服務會員嗎？那樣您可以享受折扣！

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: Not interested.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Okay, but let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
好的，如果您改變主意，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Alright, then I'll add you to my member list. I hope you'll have some Illusion equipment next time I see you.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
那麼，我會將您加入會員名單。希望下次見到您時，您能擁有幻影裝備。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
I can enchant Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
我可以為幻影裝備進行附魔。

scripts.text: How much do you charge?
scripts.translation: 收費多少？

scripts.text: Add stats to Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation: 為幻影裝備附加屬性。

scripts.text: Reset enchanted Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation: 重置幻影裝備的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
First, let me tell you that I can only enchant certain types of Illusion equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
首先，我要告訴您，我只能為特定型別的幻影裝備進行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Up to 2 sockets can be enchanted, and enchanting each socket requires 5 Illusion Stones. You can reset enchanted Illusion equipment at any time.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
最多可以附魔2個插槽，每個插槽需要5塊幻影石。您可以隨時重置幻影裝備的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Enchanting never fails, but resetting sometimes failes. Even modern science can't change that.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
附魔永遠不會失敗，但重置有時會失敗。即使是現代科學也無法改變這一點。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Resetting requires a different amount of Zeny depending on the success chance you choose. Select the menu if you'd like to see the available payment options.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
重置所需的Zeny取決於您選擇的成功率。如果您想檢視可用的支付選項，請選擇選單。

scripts.text: Right-handed Weapon
scripts.translation: 右手武器

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Shoes
scripts.translation: 長靴

scripts.text: Garment
scripts.translation: 服裝

scripts.text: Right Accessory
scripts.translation: 右手飾品

scripts.text: Left accessory
scripts.translation: 左手飾品

scripts.text: Helm (Upper)
scripts.translation: 頭盔（上）

scripts.text: Left-handed Weapon/Shield
scripts.translation: 左手武器/盾牌

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You must be equipped with an item in the selected location to have it enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
您必須在選定的位置裝備物品才能對其進行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This equipment is not from a world of fantastic illusions. I'm offended that you even showed it to me.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
這件裝備並非來自奇幻的幻覺世界。您甚至把它拿給我看，這讓我感到被冒犯了。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Random options are checked for that equipment. The equipment cannot be enchanted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000該裝備已檢查隨機選項。無法對該裝備進行附魔。^000000

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This is the best of all Illusion equipment. There's no technology available in this day and age that can enchant it. Even the most skilled enchanter can't do that.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
這是所有幻影裝備中最好的。當今沒有任何技術可以對其進行附魔。即使是技術最精湛的附魔師也無法做到。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Well, not unless he's willing to risk his mental and physical health.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
除非他願意冒著精神和身體健康的風險。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
But who knows? Maybe someday you'll meet someone who is talented enough to handle this precious equipment.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
但誰知道呢？也許有一天，您會遇到一位才華橫溢的人，能夠駕馭這件珍貴的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This equipment is already enchanted to the maximum limit.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
這件裝備的附魔已達到上限。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
What kind of effect would you like to add?
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
您想新增什麼效果？

scripts.text: Melee
scripts.translation: 近戰

scripts.text: Ranged
scripts.translation: 遠端

scripts.text: Magic
scripts.translation: 魔法

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
I'll try to enchant the {0} ability for your item. ^ff0000Its existing Refining level and cards will not be damaged. It will not be destroyed, even if this attempt fails.^000000 Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
我將嘗試為您的物品附魔{0}能力。^ff0000現有的精煉等級和卡片不會受損。即使嘗試失敗，物品也不會被破壞。^000000您想繼續嗎？

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
沒問題。如果您改變主意，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
This item requires {0} {1}, and you don't have all that I need from you.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
該物品需要{0} {1}，而您提供的材料不足。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
It's done. Please check.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
完成了。請檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Only fully enchanted items can be reset. Please enchant it twice, and if you still want to reset it, then bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
只有完全附魔的物品才能重置。請附魔兩次，如果您仍然想要重置，請將其帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Your resetting chance varies, depending on the amount of Zeny you pay. What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
您的重置成功率取決於您支付的Zeny數量。您想怎麼做？

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
沒問題。如果您改變主意，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
You don't have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
您的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
It's done. Please check.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
完成了。請檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Enchanter]
Ah, that was unfortunate. Well, you can't always be lucky.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺附魔師]
啊，真遺憾。畢竟，運氣不可能總是站在您這邊。

scripts.text:
[Equipment Researcher]
I'm the one who researches {0} to enhance armors and weapons.
If you have the materials I need for my research, wouldn't you hand them over?
If you give me some equipment and some materials, I'll exchange them for my reinforced equipment.
scripts.translation:
[裝備研究員]
我負責研究{0}以強化護甲和武器。
如果您有我研究所需的材料，願意交給我嗎？
如果您給我一些裝備和材料，我會用強化後的裝備與您交換。

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Exchange equipment
scripts.translation: 交換裝備

scripts.text:
[Equipment Researcher]
I'm working on how to use an {0} to strengthen equipment.
I went to go to the place where {1} was found, and I barely got back..
scripts.translation:
[裝備研究員]
我正在研究如何使用{0}來強化裝備。
我去了{1}被發現的地方，差點沒能回來...

scripts.text:
[Equipment Researcher]
I think I met a girl...
Anyway, after that, I couldn't find a way to go back.
Here, we're getting research materials from adventurers with {0}, and I'm offering enhanced equipment instead.
scripts.translation:
[裝備研究員]
我想我遇到了一個女孩...
總之，在那之後，我找不到回去的路了。
在這裡，我們從擁有{0}的冒險者那裡獲取研究材料，並提供強化後的裝備作為交換。

scripts.text:
[Equipment Researcher]
What are the equipment I can exchange? Wait a minute. I'll let you know.
scripts.translation:
[裝備研究員]
我可以交換哪些裝備呢？請稍等。我會告訴您的。

scripts.text:
[Equipment Researcher]
As a material, you can bring ^0000CDexisting equipment that have been refined to +9 or higher.^000000
And I need some ^0000CD{0} and other materials.^000000
scripts.translation:
[裝備研究員]
作為材料，您可以提供^0000CD精煉等級達到+9或更高的現有裝備。^000000
此外，我還需要一些^0000CD{0}和其他材料。^000000

scripts.text:
[Equipment Researcher]
Of course, we're giving you new equipment, so don't forget that all the existing ^0000CDsmelting and enchantments^000000 will disappear.
So, what kind of weapon do you want?
scripts.translation:
[裝備研究員]
當然，我們提供的是新裝備，所以請記住，現有的^0000CD熔煉和附魔^000000將會消失。
那麼，您想要哪種武器？

scripts.text:
[Village Soap]
I've also rolled up my sleeves for the adventurers who work hard for the village. Can I make your equipment stronger? Is there anything on the list you want?
scripts.translation:
[村裡的肥皂]
我也為辛勤為村莊工作的冒險者捲起了袖子。我能讓您的裝備更強嗎？列表中有您想要的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Look at the illusion equipment
scripts.translation: 檢視幻覺裝備

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Village Soap]
Please come later. Just bring the ingredients and I'll make it for you.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的肥皂]
請稍後再來。只要帶上材料，我就為您製作。

scripts.text:
[Village Soap]
Who made it? It might be useful for you to take it with you.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的肥皂]
這是誰做的？也許對您有用，可以帶在身上。

scripts.text:
Conversation cannot proceed because you have too many items.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續對話。
請整理您的物品欄後重試。

scripts.text:
[Horen]
Hello. If you have rare materials from this place, I can enhance your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[霍倫]
你好。如果您有來自此地的稀有材料，我可以強化您的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Horen]
Would you like to see upgradeable equipment?
scripts.translation:
[霍倫]
您想檢視可強化的裝備嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Horen]
Come back if interested.
scripts.translation:
[霍倫]
如果您感興趣，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Horen]
There are many types, so take your time. If you want something, I can enhance it right away.
scripts.translation:
[霍倫]
種類很多，請慢慢挑選。如果您想要某樣東西，我可以立即為您強化。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[From]
I feel like I'm going crazy.
It's because of my mood. I'm human and it's not like you're mistaken.
I'll help you if you get a lot here.
Do you want to enhance your equipment?
scripts.translation:
[寄自]
我感覺自己快要瘋了。
這是因為我的情緒。我是人類，您並沒有誤會。
如果您在這裡獲得很多材料，我會幫助您。
您想要強化您的裝備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Illusion Merchant]
I'm selling two random optional weapon grant scrolls that I made myself. You can choose the payment method you like.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺商人]
我正在出售兩張我親手製作的隨機可選武器賦予卷軸。您可以選擇您喜歡的支付方式。

scripts.text: Purchase with Zeny.
scripts.translation: 使用Zeny購買

scripts.text: Purchase with Illusion Stones
scripts.translation: 使用幻影石購買

scripts.text:
[Illusion Merchant]
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺商人]
希望您喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Illusion Merchant]
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[幻覺商人]
希望您喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
If you give me an {1}, I'll do something nice for you!
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
如果你給我{1}，我會為你做一件好事！

scripts.text: Reason for being here
scripts.translation: 來到這裡的原因

scripts.text: Good thing [Illusion equipment]
scripts.translation: 好的[幻覺裝備]

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
I don't know why...!
The other teddy bears were in line, so I was in line too!
Whoaaaaaa!!!!
I didn't know it was here!
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
我不知道為什麼...！
其他的泰迪熊都在排隊，所以我也在排隊！
哇啊啊啊！！！！
我不知道這裡會有這個！

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
A teddy bear with an {1}!
Strong!
I don't have any {2}s!
Less... stronger...
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
一隻擁有{1}的泰迪熊！
好強！
我沒有{2}！
少...更強...

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
What are {1}s?
I don't know but I want some!
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
{1}是什麼？
我不知道，但我想要一些！

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
Makes you good with what you have!
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
讓你擁有的東西變得更好！

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
If you want to do well, bring equipment refined to ^ff0000+9 or higher. It'll all disappear... haha?^000000
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
如果你想表現得好，請帶來精煉到^ff0000+9或更高的裝備。它們都會消失...哈哈？^000000

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
^ff0000{1}^000000!!! {2} is the most important thing, but... other materials are also needed.
For every good thing you need another good thing.
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
^ff0000{1}^000000！！！{2}是最重要的，但是...還需要其他材料。
想要好的東西，就需要另一個好的東西。

scripts.text:
[Bear Wanting {0}]
Okay...
scripts.translation:
[想要{0}的熊]
好的...
